summary.en: Classifies coding turns with Jev and applies a policy to select a model and reasoning depth, with logging and fallback behavior.
summary.zh: 按编程任务难度选择模型与推理深度。

evidence.basis: Existing repository review and linked documentation; metadata migration on 2026-09-20, no new runtime validation.

en: the reported roughly 60% savings comes from the author's replay of 237 real turns. It is not a SeeAPI measurement or a guaranteed saving.
zh: 约 60% 成本下降来自作者对 237 个真实 turn 的回放自测，不是 SeeAPI 实测或普遍承诺。

summary.en: A Discord moderation bot that evaluates messages and context for phishing, spam, and social engineering. Code applies escalating actions, and moderator corrections become safe precedents in later judgment context.
summary.zh: Discord 社区中的钓鱼、垃圾信息及社交工程消息审核。

evidence.basis: Existing repository review and linked documentation; metadata migration on 2026-09-20, no new runtime validation.

en: a text-message moderation project, not an image or video NSFW benchmark. False-positive performance has not been independently verified here.
zh: 这里核实的是文字消息审核方案，不是图片或视频 NSFW 模型；未独立测量误报率。

title.zh: jev-rerank-bench — 检索重排对照评测

summary.en: Compares Jev relevance rubrics with other rerankers on shared BM25 candidates and publishes saved responses and scoring code.
summary.zh: 基于相同 BM25 候选，对比 Jev 相关性评分与其他重排模型，公开保存的响应和评分代码。

evidence.basis: Existing repository review and linked documentation; metadata migration on 2026-09-20, no new runtime validation.

en: The headline averages do not establish a winner; weighting datasets versus queries changes the comparison.
zh: 汇总均值不足以确定胜者；按数据集或按查询加权会改变比较结果。

summary.en: Reviews diffs or codebases through staged judgments about risk, file profiles, evidence, mechanisms, severity, and conditional reviewer routing.
summary.zh: 通过风险定位、文件分析、证据选择、机制分类和严重度判断，为代码审查提供分阶段线索。

evidence.basis: Existing repository review and linked documentation; metadata migration on 2026-09-20, no new runtime validation.

en: an experiment that currently does not integrate compiler diagnostics or static analyzers. Findings are review leads, not proof of defects.
zh: 作者将其定位为实验；当前不集成编译器诊断或静态分析，结果是审查线索而非缺陷证明。

title.en: Jev Search — intent selection and result reranking
title.zh: Jev Search — 自然语言搜索意图识别与结果重排

summary.en: A TypeScript application asks Jev to select search sources, time ranges, and query candidates, fetches results through Search1API, then judges title/snippet relevance in batches. Code merges URLs and ranks results by relevance, engine agreement, and original position.
summary.zh: TypeScript 应用先让 Jev 选择搜索源、时间范围与检索词候选，经 Search1API 获取结果后，批量判断标题及摘要相关性；代码合并 URL，按相关性、引擎一致性与原始名次排序。

evidence.basis: Existing repository review and linked documentation; metadata migration on 2026-09-20, no new runtime validation.

en: Relevance scores do not verify page facts; snippets can be incomplete or stale. A search can make several provider calls. Source and ranking code were inspected, but retrieval quality, latency, and cost were not measured.
zh: 相关性分数不验证网页事实，摘要可能不完整或过时；一次搜索可能触发多次供应商调用。本轮查阅了接口与排序管线代码，未测量检索质量、时延或费用。

summary.en: Evaluates prompt-injection detection and vulnerable-code judgments with published datasets and per-sample results.
summary.zh: 用公开数据与逐条结果评测提示注入检测和代码漏洞判断。

evidence.basis: Existing repository review and linked documentation; metadata migration on 2026-09-20, no new runtime validation.

en: Reported results depend on context and thresholds; this is not an NSFW benchmark or a complete security boundary.
zh: 作者报告的结果受上下文与阈值影响；不是 NSFW 评测，也不构成完整安全边界。

summary.en: Email classification experiments comparing natural-language Jev decision criteria with TF-IDF classifiers and combined scores, including tests across different mail sources and time periods.
summary.zh: 垃圾邮件及钓鱼邮件分类评估。

evidence.basis: Existing repository review and linked documentation; metadata migration on 2026-09-20, no new runtime validation.

en: exploratory author-reported experiments. The criteria were refined after inspecting labeled errors, so “no task-specific training” should not be confused with “no supervision.” We have not reproduced the results.
zh: 作者明确标注为探索性实验；分类标准在查看部分标注样本错误后调整，不能描述为完全没有人工监督。未复现实验。

summary.en: A browser agent that turns visible controls into indexed candidates. Jev chooses an operation and target; a separate language model writes text when needed.
summary.zh: 将浏览器中可见控件整理为候选项，由 Jev 选择操作与目标，需要输入文本时再使用独立语言模型。

evidence.basis: Existing repository review and linked documentation; metadata migration on 2026-09-20, no new runtime validation.

en: the reported roughly 7.1-second flight search is a specific author-measured run, timed after the initial page observation. It is not a general browser-task speed guarantee.
zh: 作者报告的约 7.1 秒航班搜索是特定任务演示，计时从首次页面观察之后开始，不是任意网页任务的速度保证。

title.zh: Safer with Jev（原 TypeSafe on Neon）

summary.en: An HTTP gate that checks prompt injections, unsafe images, and unsafe replies before optionally forwarding a request. Its image pipeline first uses `gemini-3-flash` to describe the image, then asks Jev to judge risks in that description.
summary.zh: 在内容转发或上传前检查提示词注入、图片风险及模型回复风险。

evidence.basis: Existing repository review and linked documentation; metadata migration on 2026-09-20, no new runtime validation.

en: this is a vision-model-plus-Jev pipeline, not evidence of native image classification by Jev. The current project is a safety gate; earlier descriptions of it as a model router are outdated. We have not measured its detection accuracy.
zh: 不是 Jev 原生视觉 NSFW 检测的证据，也没有在本次核查中验证识别效果。原帖的“模型 Router”介绍已不符合当前 README。

summary.en: A Chrome extension asks Jev about relevance, promotional content and depth, then reranks Google results in code.
summary.zh: Chrome 扩展使用 Jev 判断搜索结果的相关性、推广倾向和信息深度，再由代码重排 Google 搜索结果。

evidence.basis: Existing repository review and linked documentation; metadata migration on 2026-09-20, no new runtime validation.

en: Judgments use result snippets rather than full pages; search intent affects filtering.
zh: 依据搜索摘要而非网页全文；过滤策略会考虑搜索意图。

title.zh: Transcript Scorecard — 实时客服通话质检

summary.en: A proof of concept replays fictional support-call transcripts incrementally. Each enabled criterion contributes a Score and a Choice selecting an evidence sentence; code normalizes and weights the results, then stores the final evaluation in SQLite.
summary.zh: 概念验证项目逐句重放虚构客服通话文本。每个启用维度对应一个 Score 和一个选择证据句的 Choice，由代码归一化、加权，并将最终评估存入 SQLite。

evidence.basis: Existing repository review and linked documentation; metadata migration on 2026-09-20, no new runtime validation.

en: This is transcript replay, not verified live audio recognition. Evaluations send the current transcript prefix to TypeSafe; costs can grow with the conversation. The documented local demo has no authentication. Scoring quality and timing were not reproduced.
zh: 展示的是文本重放，不能视为已验证的实时语音识别。每次评估发送当前转写前缀，费用可能随对话增长；文档说明本地演示无认证。未复现评分质量或时延。

summary.en: Adds Jev semantic checks to Zod schemas, turning probabilities into validation issues alongside ordinary shape checks.
summary.zh: 在 Zod 格式校验之上加入 Jev 语义判断，将概率转为校验结果，适合检查内容含义、分类与描述是否匹配。

evidence.basis: Existing repository review and linked documentation; metadata migration on 2026-09-20, no new runtime validation.

en: Uncertain and unavailable judgments need explicit handling; a passing check does not establish factual correctness.
zh: 需要处理不确定和服务不可用的结果；通过校验不代表事实一定正确。
